title: P0.30: Metacognitive Direct Audit + ChatGPT Profile Isolation + Starvation Detection
description: Three issues: (1) metacognitive queries like 'autoauditoria' or 'estado de tests' fell to heavy local chat instead of being answered from structured evidence files. (2) After a ChatGPT failure, a new consultation request ('haz una consulta a chatgpt') was captured by the follow-up handler instead of routing as a fresh consultation. (3) When browser_security_verification blocked ChatGPT, the user was not told that IABV uses an isolated profile, not their normal Chrome.
reason: No guard existed to intercept metacognitive queries before _try_handle_lightweight_chat. _try_handle_external_failure_followup matched 'chatgpt' in its patterns even when the user explicitly requested a new consultation. Failure followup messages did not explain the isolated profile context.
next_action: Validate on Windows: (1) 'dime el estado de tests' responds <5s from evidence, (2) 'haz una consulta a chatgpt' after a failure routes as new consultation, (3) browser_security_verification failure includes isolated profile explanation.
resume_hint: P0.30 code fix applied: _is_direct_self_audit_query() detects metacognitive patterns, _answer_direct_self_audit_query() reads structured evidence files, _is_new_chatgpt_consultation() skips followup handler for fresh requests, isolated profile note added when browser_security_verification is involved, OSES _metacognitive_starvation_findings() detects missing evidence.

metadata.root_cause: Bug 1: sendChat() routing chain had no guard for metacognitive queries before _try_handle_lightweight_chat, so they fell to heavy Ollama inference. Bug 2: _EXTERNAL_FAILURE_FOLLOWUP_PATTERNS included 'chatgpt' which matched new consultation requests. Bug 3: failure followup summary did not mention isolated IABV profile when terminal_state was browser_security_verification.
